risks.risk: The camera may not be a D810 model
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the model name on the camera body or a menu screenshot showing D810.

risks.risk: The camera may not power on or all functions may not work
risks.proof: Video of the camera powering on, navigating menus, taking a photo, and reviewing it.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not working or for parts.

risks.risk: Sensor, mirror, or lens glass may have scratches, fungus, or damage
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the lens elements, mirror box, and sensor with mirror locked up, plus sample images.

risks.risk: Shutter count and usage history are unknown
risks.proof: Screenshot of the shutter count from the camera menu or a metadata reading.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as high-mileage with unknown usage.

risks.risk: Battery, charger, strap, box, or other accessories may be missing
risks.proof: Photo showing all included accessories together with the camera.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as camera body and lens only, with no accessories.

risks.risk: Age, repairs, or damage history are undisclosed
risks.proof: Purchase receipt, repair records, or serial-number check with Nikon.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as out of warranty with unknown repair history.

risks.risk: The photo may not be of the actual item for sale because of the watermark
risks.proof: Video or additional photos showing the same camera with a handwritten note including the buyer's name or date.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as if the photo may not represent the actual item.
